arxiv-2102-00069.title: Bochner-Riesz Means Convergence of Prolate Spheroidal Series and Their Extensions
arxiv-2102-00069.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the L p L^{p} -Bochner-Riesz mean summability problem related to the spectrum of some particular Sturm-Liouville operators in the weighted L p ​ ( [ a , b ] , ω ) . L^{p}([a,b],\omega).

arxiv-2207-01312.title: Vietnamese Capitalization and Punctuation Recovery Models
arxiv-2207-01312.creator: Hoang Thi Thu Uyen, Nguyen Anh Tu, Ta Duc Huy
arxiv-2207-01312.description: Abstract Despite the rise of recent performant methods in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), such methods do not ensure proper casing and punctuation for their outputs. This problem has a significant impact on the comprehension of both Natural Language Processing (NLP) algorithms and human to process. Capitalization and punctuation restoration is imperative in pre-processing pipelines for raw textual inputs.

arxiv-2210-14695.title: Information Shift Dynamics Described by Tsallis q = 3 q=3 Entropy on a Compact Phase Space
arxiv-2210-14695.creator: Jin Yan, Christian Beck
arxiv-2210-14695.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jin Yan, Christian Beck. Recent mathematical investigations have shown that under very general conditions exponential mixing implies the Bernoulli property. As a concrete example of a statistical mechanics which is exponentially mixing we consider a Bernoulli shift dynamics by Chebyshev maps of arbitrary order N ≥ 2 N\geq 2 , which maximizes Tsallis q = 3 q=3 entropy rather than the ordinary q = 1 q=1 Boltzmann-Gibbs entropy. Such an information shift dynamics may be relevant in a pre-universe before ordinary space-time is created.

arxiv-2212-00825.title: Counting linearly polarized gluons with lattice QCD
arxiv-2212-00825.creator: Shuai Zhao
arxiv-2212-00825.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shuai Zhao. We outline an approach to calculate the transverse-momentum-dependent distribution of linearly polarized gluons inside an unpolarized hadron on the lattice with the help of large momentum effective theory. To achieve this purpose, we propose calculating a Euclidean version of the degree of polarization for a fast-moving hadron on the lattice, which is ultraviolet finite, and no soft function subtraction is needed.

arxiv-2308-14086.title: The Morse Smale property for time-periodic scalar reaction-diffusion equation on the circle Thanks: Corresponding author. Partially supported by NSF of China No.11971232, 12071217

arxiv-2310-13488.title: Discontinuous phase transition from ferromagnetic to oscillating states in a nonequilibrium mean-field spin model
arxiv-2310-13488.creator: Laura Guislain, Eric Bertin
arxiv-2310-13488.description: Abstract We study a nonequilibrium ferromagnetic mean-field spin model exhibiting a phase with spontaneous temporal oscillations of the magnetization, on top of the usual paramagnetic and ferromagnetic phases. This behavior is obtained by introducing dynamic field variables coupled to the spins through non-reciprocal couplings.

arxiv-2311-07390.title: Evaluating the Significance of Outdoor Advertising from Driver’s Perspective Using Computer Vision PubID: pubid: 979-8-3503-4353-3/23/$31.00 ©2023 IEEE
arxiv-2311-07390.creator: 1 st Zuzana Černeková, 2 nd Zuzana Berger Haladová, 3 rd Ján Špirka, 4 th Viktor Kocur
arxiv-2311-07390.description: Abstract Outdoor advertising, such as roadside billboards, plays a significant role in marketing campaigns but can also be a distraction for drivers, potentially leading to accidents. In this study, we propose a pipeline for evaluating the significance of roadside billboards in videos captured from a driver’s perspective.

arxiv-2401-14343.title: Class-attribute Priors: Adapting Optimization to Heterogeneity and Fairness Objective
arxiv-2401-14343.creator: Xuechen Zhang, Mingchen Li, Jiasi Chen, Christos Thrampoulidis, Samet Oymak
arxiv-2401-14343.description: Abstract Modern classification problems exhibit heterogeneities across individual classes: Each class may have unique attributes, such as sample size, label quality, or predictability (easy vs difficult), and variable importance at test-time. Without care, these heterogeneities impede the learning process, most notably, when optimizing fairness objectives.

arxiv-2407-15658.title: Anisotropy of the zigzag order in the Kitaev honeycomb magnet α \alpha -RuBr 3
arxiv-2407-15658.creator: John S. Pearce, David A. S. Kaib, Zeyu Ma, Danrui Ni, R. J. Cava, Roser Valentí, Radu Coldea, Amalia I. Coldea
arxiv-2407-15658.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by John S. Pearce, David A. S. Kaib, Zeyu Ma, Danrui Ni, R. J. Cava, Roser Valentí, Radu Coldea, Amalia I. Coldea. Kitaev materials often order magnetically at low temperatures due to the presence of non-Kitaev interactions. Torque magnetometry is a very sensitive technique for probing the magnetic anisotropy, which is critical in understanding the magnetic ground state.

arxiv-2408-01836.title: Carroll black holes in (A)dS and their higher-derivative modifications
arxiv-2408-01836.creator: Poula Tadros, Ivan Kolář
arxiv-2408-01836.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Poula Tadros, Ivan Kolář. We define the Carrollian black holes corresponding to the limit of Schwarzschild-(A)dS spacetime and its higher-derivative counterpart known as Schwarzschild-Bach-(A)dS spacetime, which is also a static spherically symmetric vacuum solution of quadratic gravity. By analyzing motion of massive particles in these geometries, we found that: In the case of Schwarzschild-(A)dS, a (nearly) tangential particle from infinity will wind around the extremal surface with a finite number of windings depending on the impact parameter and the cosmological constant.

arxiv-2506-23314.title: Interpretable by Design: MH-AutoML for Transparent and Efficient Android Malware Detection without Compromising Performance
arxiv-2506-23314.creator: Joner Assolin 1 1 Federal University of Amazonas (UFAM) Gabriel Canto 1 1 Federal University of Amazonas (UFAM) Diego Kreutz 2 2 Federal University of Pampa (UNIPAMPA), Eduardo Feitosa 1 1 Federal University of Amazonas (UFAM) Hendrio Bragança 1 1 Federal University of Amazonas (UFAM) Angelo Nogueir
arxiv-2506-23314.description: Abstract Malware detection in Android systems requires both cybersecurity expertise and machine learning (ML) techniques. Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) has emerged as an approach to simplify ML development by reducing the need for specialized knowledge. However, current AutoML solutions typically operate as black-box systems with limited transparency, interpretability, and experiment traceability.

arxiv-2507-21991.title: Does magnetic field promote or suppress fragmentation in AGN disks? Results from local shearing box simulations with simple cooling. 2015 Does magnetic field promote or suppress fragmentation in AGN disks? Results from local shearing box simulations with simple cooling. – 27
arxiv-2507-21991.creator: Tsun Hin Navin Tsung, Mitchell C. Begelman, Philip J. Armitage, Yan-Fei Jiang (姜燕飞), Hannalore J. Gerling-Dunsmore
arxiv-2507-21991.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tsun Hin Navin Tsung, Mitchell C. Begelman, Philip J. Armitage, Yan-Fei Jiang (姜燕飞), Hannalore J. Gerling-Dunsmore. Accretion disks in Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) are predicted to become gravitationally unstable substantially interior to the black hole’s sphere of influence, at radii where the disk is simultaneously unstable to the magnetorotational instability (MRI). Using local shearing box simulations with net vertical flux and a simple cooling prescription, we investigate the effect of magnetic fields on fragmentation in the limit of ideal magnetohydrodyamics.

arxiv-2509-18940.title: Extending total colorings in planar graphs
arxiv-2509-18940.creator: Owen Henderschedt, Jessica McDonald
arxiv-2509-18940.description: Abstract We initiate the study of total-coloring extensions, and focus our attention on planar graphs, asking: “When can a total- k k -coloring of some subgraph H H of a planar graph G G be extended to a total- k k -coloring of G G ?

arxiv-2510-01337.title: On the Identifiability of Latent Action Policies
arxiv-2510-01337.creator: Sébastien Lachapelle
arxiv-2510-01337.description: Abstract We study the identifiability of latent action policy learning (LAPO), a framework introduced recently to discover representations of actions from video data. We formally describe desiderata for such representations, their statistical benefits and potential sources of unidentifiability. Finally, we prove that an entropy-regularized LAPO objective identifies action representations satisfying our desiderata, under suitable conditions.

arxiv-2510-19628.title: CrossNews-UA : A Cross-lingual News Semantic Similarity Benchmark for Ukrainian, Polish, Russian, and English
arxiv-2510-19628.description: Abstract In the era of social networks and rapid misinformation spread, news analysis remains a critical task. Detecting fake news across multiple languages, particularly beyond English, poses significant challenges. Cross-lingual news comparison offers a promising approach to verify information by leveraging external sources in different languages 6 .

arxiv-2601-04069.title: Hybrid Downlink Beamforming with Outage Constraints under Imperfect CSI using Model-Driven Deep Learning
arxiv-2601-04069.creator: Lukas Schynol 1 and Marius Pesavento 1
arxiv-2601-04069.description: Abstract We consider energy-efficient multi-user hybrid downlink beamforming (BF) and power allocation under imperfect channel state information (CSI) and probabilistic outage constraints. In this domain, classical optimization methods resort to computationally costly conic optimization problems. Meanwhile, generic deep network (DN) architectures lack interpretability and require large training data sets to generalize well.

arxiv-2601-13919.title: HyperWalker: Dynamic Hypergraph-Based Deep Diagnosis for Multi-Hop Clinical Modeling across EHR and X-Ray in Medical VLMs
arxiv-2601-13919.creator: Yuezhe Yang, Hao Wang, Yige Peng, Jinman Kim, Lei Bi
arxiv-2601-13919.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuezhe Yang, Hao Wang, Yige Peng, Jinman Kim, Lei Bi. Automated clinical diagnosis remains a core challenge in medical AI, which usually requires models to integrate multi-modal data and reason across complex, case-specific contexts. Although recent methods have advanced medical report generation (MRG) and visual question answering (VQA) with medical vision-language models (VLMs), these methods, however, predominantly operate under a sample-isolated inference paradigm, as such processing cases independently without access to longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) or structurally related patient examples.

plos-pone-0008516.title: Monoamine Oxidase A Gene (MAOA) Associated with Attitude Towards Longshot Risks
plos-pone-0008516.creator: Songfa Zhong, Salomon Israel, Hong Xue et al.
plos-pone-0008516.description: PLOS ONE research article. Decision making often entails longshot risks involving a small chance of receiving a substantial outcome. People tend to be risk preferring (averse) when facing longshot risks involving significant gains (losses). This differentiation towards longshot risks underpins the markets

pmc-10560272.title: Enhancing microstructure and mechanical properties of nickel aluminium bronze alloy through tin addition
pmc-10560272.creator: Sushanth Poojary, Vikas Marakini, Rajath N. Rao, Vijeesh Vijayan
pmc-10560272.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This article describes the changes in the microstructure, cooling curve characteristics and mechanical properties of cast Nickel Aluminium Bronze alloy (NAB) alloy that were produced by the addition of various amounts of Tin (Sn). The solidification parameters were recorded using a computer-aided cooling curve analysis setup, and optical and scanning electron microscopes were utilised to study the evolution of the microstructure.

pmc-10690465.title: Psychiatric Comorbidities and Schizophrenia in Youths With Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder
pmc-10690465.creator: Soo Min Jeon, Dong Yun Lee, SangHun Cha, Jin-Won Kwon
pmc-10690465.description: This cohort study evaluates the association between psychiatric comorbidities and schizophrenia in children and adolescents with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder. Introduction Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is the most common neurodevelopmental disorder in children and adolescents, characterized by impulsivity, hyperactivity, and poor attention.1 There is growing evidence that ADHD is commonly associated with schizophrenia.

pmc-11360598.title: Sugar Transporter HmSWEET8 Cooperates with HmSTP1 to Enhance Powdery Mildew Susceptibility in Heracleum moellendorffii Hance
pmc-11360598.creator: Hanbing Liu, Junxia Liu, Xiaohui Si, Shuhong Zhang, Lili Zhang, Xuejiao Tong, Xihong Yu, Xinmei Jiang, Yao Cheng
pmc-11360598.description: The powdery mildew caused by Eeysiphe heraclei is a serious concern in Heracleum moellendorffii Hance. Therefore, exploring the mechanisms underlying sugar efflux from host cells to the fungus during the plant–fungus interaction showed great significance. The study successfully cloned HmSWEET8 and HmSTP1 genes based on RNA-seq technology. The complementation assays in yeast EBY.VW4000 found HmSWEET8 and HmSTP1 transporting hexose.

pmc-11390711.title: Auditory objects in working memory include task-irrelevant features
pmc-11390711.creator: Cora Fischer, Carina Nolting, Flavia Schneider, Christoph Bledowski, Jochen Kaiser
pmc-11390711.description: Object-based attention operates both in perception and visual working memory. While the efficient perception of auditory stimuli also requires the formation of auditory objects, little is known about their role in auditory working memory (AWM). To investigate whether attention to one object feature in AWM leads to the involuntary maintenance of another, task-irrelevant feature, we conducted four experiments.

pmc-11545012.title: Breast Cancer and Mental Health: Incidence and Influencing Factors—A Claims Data Analysis from Germany
pmc-11545012.creator: Alexandra von Au, Dominik Dannehl, Tjeerd Maarten Hein Dijkstra, Raphael Gutsfeld, Anna Sophie Scholz, Kathrin Hassdenteufel, Markus Hahn, Sabine Hawighorst-Knapstein, Alexandra Isaksson, Ariane Chaudhuri, Armin Bauer, Markus Wallwiener, Diethelm Wallwiener, Sara Yvonne Brucker, Andreas Daniel Hartk
pmc-11545012.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigates how frequently breast cancer patients develop mental disorders compared to a control group without breast cancer. We analyzed data from over 11,000 breast cancer patients and nearly 32,000 healthy controls, finding that breast cancer patients were significantly more likely to suffer from mental disorders. Anxiety disorders, hypochondria, adjustment disorders, and depression were particularly common.

pmc-12497495.title: Coexistence of Hypothyroidism and Vitiligo Vulgaris: A Case Report
pmc-12497495.creator: Pankaj Kumar, Md Jawed Akhtar
pmc-12497495.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Vitiligo vulgaris is a chronic depigmenting disorder commonly linked to autoimmune diseases, particularly autoimmune thyroid conditions. We report a case of a 34-year-old female patient with well-controlled primary hypothyroidism for four years who, during a routine follow-up at the outpatient thyroid clinic in the nuclear medicine department of a tertiary care centre, noted the recent appearance of asymptomatic depigmented patches on her right forearm and left leg. Dermatological examination confirmed a diagnosis of vitiligo vulgaris.

pmc-12616490.title: Urbanization and Habitat Diversity Promote Endozoochorous Seed Dispersal by Raccoon Dogs Within Forest Fragments in Tokyo
pmc-12616490.creator: Harsh Yadav, Yuki Iwachido, Shyam S Phartyal, Takehiro Sasaki
pmc-12616490.description: Urbanization affects biodiversity and essential ecological functions, such as animal‐mediated seed dispersal. Novel urban habitats introduce environmental heterogeneity that alters the effectiveness of animal‐mediated seed dispersal. Despite growing urbanization, the additive effect of urban indicators on habitat diversity in shaping animal‐mediated seed dispersal by urban mammals remains poorly understood.

pmc-12874377.title: Assessing Polymorph Stability and Phase Transitions at Finite Temperature: Integrating Crystal Structure Prediction, Lattice Dynamics, and Molecular Dynamics
pmc-12874377.creator: Gabriela B. Correa, Stefanos Konstantinopoulos, Benjamin I. Tan, Yong Zhang, Frederico W. Tavares, Claire S. Adjiman, Edward J. Maginn
pmc-12874377.description: Determining finite-temperature polymorph stability and phase transitions remains a major challenge in crystal structure prediction (CSP). While static lattice energy methods, the zeroth-order CSP, may offer some initial insights, they neglect vibrational and entropic contributions that can influence stability under real-world conditions.

pmc-13263200.title: Early-onset rice body synovitis of the knee in children under three years: a case series and review of the literature
pmc-13263200.creator: LunQing Zhu, Cong Liu, Yao Liu, BingQing Mao, YouHui Huang, Jun Wen, YiCong Liu, Tao Qian

pmc-13572049.title: Opportunistic Upper Endoscopy at the Time of Screening Colonoscopy: Feasibility, Acceptability, and Patient Perspectives
pmc-13572049.creator: Haejin In, Katherine De la Torre-Cisneros, Brijesh Rana, Priscille Myrthil-Harder, Alexandra Adams, Ishita Dalal, Anish Patel, Keerthana Kesavarapu, Zhongren Zhou, Nirag Jhala, Elizabeth Handorf, Anita Kinney
pmc-13572049.description: Background and AimsGastric cancer is highly lethal due to late stage at discovery in the United States, yet no routine screening strategy exists. Opportunistic upper endoscopy (esophagogastroduodenoscopy [EGD]) performed during screening colonoscopy (concomitant EGD and routine colonoscopy [EGD-SC]) may provide a practical approach to early detection. We evaluated the feasibility, acceptability, patient perspectives, and diagnostic yield of EGD-SC.

pmc-13583878.title: Identification and functional characterisation of SCO1 as a mitochondria-related biomarker in lupus nephritis
pmc-13583878.creator: Haiping Xie, Jianwen Liu, Juanjuan He, Yunfeng Dai, Fei Gao, Yanfang Wu, Zhihan Chen
pmc-13583878.description: BackgroundLupus nephritis (LN) is a severe complication of systemic lupus erythematosus. Mitochondrial dysfunction and inflammation are key contributors to its pathogenesis, yet the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood and reliable biomarkers are limited. This study investigates mitochondrial-related genes (MRGs) in LN and evaluates their potential as biomarkers.

pmc-7616764.title: Similarities and differences in the functions of non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) across gender non-conforming and cisgender young adults
pmc-7616764.creator: Nina M. Lutz, Samuel R. Chamberlain, Jon E. Grant, Christine Lochner, Paul O. Wilkinson, Tamsin J. Ford, Sharon A.S. Neufeld
pmc-7616764.description: BackgroundNon-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) can be motivated by a broad range of functions and many individuals report multiple reasons for self-injuring. Most NSSI research has involved predominantly female samples and few studies have examined gender similarities and differences in function endorsement.
